reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for reviewing code changes through turn-level summaries, searchable file trees, syntax-aware diffs, and guarded per-turn undo with filesystem checks.

summaries.zh: 用于在 DeepSeek Harness 中查看代码变更、浏览文件差异并通过受保护的快照执行逐轮撤销。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for inspecting turn-level code changes, browsing file diffs, and performing guarded undo operations from recorded snapshots.

capabilities: Displays turn-level code changes and unified diffs
Reads workspace-relative files and file metadata for review
Records review metadata and before-and-after filesystem snapshots
Can write files to perform guarded undo operations
Adds configurable diff highlighting, layout, and font settings
Can enumerate local system fonts when requested
